data.q: Where does the consumption data come from?
data.a: Meter data is pulled automatically every day from the distribution companies' automated meter reading systems (OSOS) and the supported integrations.

bills.a: Every line of the bill is recalculated from your tariff and measured consumption, so you can compare energy, distribution, power, overrun and reactive charges with your real bill.

carbon.q: Which standards does the carbon calculation follow?
carbon.a: Results are reported by ISO 14064 category and GHG Protocol scope (Scope 1, 2 and 3).

install.q: Can we install it on our own servers?
install.a: Yes. EkoKod runs in the cloud or on your own servers.

calculator.title: Electricity bill calculator
calculator.description: Estimate the energy, distribution, power and overrun charges and VAT of your bill using the prices in the national tariff schedule.
calculator.binomialHint: Double term exists only at medium voltage.
calculator.resultEmpty: Enter the details and press Calculate.
calculator.plusGroup: The daily consumption threshold was exceeded, so the high-use price applies.

rules.bands: A multi-time tariff needs T1, T2 and T3 together; if a total is also entered it must equal their sum. A single-time tariff uses the total, or the sum of the T values when only they are entered.
rules.power: The power charge is the monthly price × contracted power × days / 30. If measured demand exceeds the contracted power, the excess is added at the overrun price.
rules.vat: VAT is charged on energy, distribution, power and overrun together. Other items such as the municipal consumption tax are not included; the result is an estimate.

basis.total: Energy was priced on the total consumption.
basis.bands: Energy was priced on T1, T2 and T3 at their own prices.
